entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to request the establishment of bearers for user data transfer or to respond to paging.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to initiate the service request procedure.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE state indicating it is registered with the network.

entities.name: Key set identifier
entities.description: Identifies the security key set to be used.

entities.name: Service type
entities.description: Indicates the type of service being requested.

relations.description: Service request procedure includes sending the SERVICE REQUEST message.
Service request procedure requires the UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
SERVICE REQUEST message contains the Key set identifier IE.
SERVICE REQUEST message contains the Service type IE.
Service request procedure is triggered by sending the SERVICE REQUEST message.
